title: zenDot: An LLM-integrated quantum TCAD platform for semiconductor quantum-device design and optimization automation
summary: Semiconductor quantum-device design still lacks an integrated Technology Computer-Aided Design (TCAD)-like environment that connects material geometry, quantum many-body simulation, and automated design. Here we introduce zenDot, a large-language model (LLM)-integrated quantum TCAD platform that links a material-labelled device state to a unified condensed-matter physics toolbox. The device and calculation components are integrated into a desktop workbench, Python API, and an embedded LLM agent, allowing electrostatics, charge and transport characterization, correlated-state calculations,…
